entities.name: Engel Beltré
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Engel Manuel Beltré is a Dominican professional baseball outfielder who is a free agent. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Texas Rangers. Born in the Dominican Republic, he plays for the Spain national baseball team in international competition.
